item.title: 【UPSCALED】Avril Lavigne - The Best Damn Thing (1080p Upscale ProRes)
item.description:
​

Hello everyone! This time, I’ve upscaled Avril Lavigne’s The Best Damn Thing, and I’m really excited to share it with you all! I used the MASTER 512i as the source to achieve better quality and worked carefully to enhance the details while keeping the natural grain and texture intact. I put a lot of effort into making it look sharp and clean, and as you can see from the screenshot I uploaded, the result turned out great. Hope you enjoy it, and have a great day everyone!
